feed.title: Feed Type
feed.description: Which view of the Protections Report is shown: 'purposes' (why we blocked them), 'companies' (who tried to watch you), 'top-sites' (where they tried to watch you), 'activity' (when they tried to watch you), 'recognition' (what they use to identify you) or 'compare' (how Chrome compares). A view with no data this week opens the first one that has data instead. 'privacy-stats' is the retired summary, now only used by the legacy UI; the new UI opens the first view that has data in its place.

showBurnAnimation.description: Boolean flag to explicitly enable or disable the burn animations

showProtectionsReportNewLabel.description: Display or hide the 'New' badge (label) on the protections report
